gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all custom fields in my Jira instance to understand what data points are available for my projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of all custom fields, including their IDs, names, and types.

gold.user: As a product owner, I need to create a new custom field to capture specific user feedback in our project management tool.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating the custom field has been created, along with its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch a paginated list of custom fields to efficiently manage large sets of data.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a paginated list of custom fields, including total count and next page link.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to view all trashed fields to decide which ones to restore or permanently delete.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a paginated list of trashed fields, including their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a team lead, I need to update the configuration of an existing custom field to better suit our project requirements.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the custom field has been updated with the new settings.

gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve the contexts associated with a specific custom field to understand where it is applicable.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of contexts for the specified custom field.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to delete a custom field that is no longer needed to keep our Jira instance clean.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the custom field has been deleted.

gold.user: As a project manager, I need to restore a previously deleted custom field to regain access to important data.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating that the custom field has been restored.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to trash a custom field that is no longer relevant to prevent confusion among team members.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the custom field has been moved to the trash.
